data.name: Triple Dice Monsters
data.detailed_description:
Dice × Monster Raising × Party Building!

Triple Dice Monsters is a turn-based RPG where you raise monsters, build your own party, and battle using dice. Raise monsters through a board game-style adventure, then let the dice decide the outcome of every battle in a unique blend of luck and strategy.

Raise Monsters

In Raising Mode, choose a monster and set off on a board game-style adventure!

Roll three dice and choose the result you want to move across the board. Battles and events await on every space. Win battles to choose one of three rewards and strengthen your monster's stats or abilities. Keep growing your monster until you're defeated or reach the end of the board to create a truly unique companion!

Challenge Bosses

In Boss Challenge Mode, build a party using the monsters you've raised and take on a variety of unique bosses!

Go all-in with an offensive team, counter each boss with specialized strategies, or create your own tactics and party composition to claim victory!

Dice-Based Battles

Every monster has six unique action skills, each assigned to one of the six dice faces.

Each turn, roll three dice and simply choose one result. Your monsters will automatically use the action skill tied to that number. The controls are simple, but choosing the right party and making the most of your dice rolls is the key to victory.

Inheritance System

The Inheritance System is the heart of Triple Dice Monsters' deep progression.

In Raising Mode, you can assign up to two previously raised monsters as Inheritance Monsters. During special inheritance events on the board, their abilities can be passed on to the monster you're currently raising. Chain inheritances together to create even stronger monsters. Mastering the Inheritance System and choosing the right combinations is the key to creating the ultimate monster!
